requirements.statement: The current canonical OpenAPI bytes, structural inventory, known completeness gaps, and generated contract snapshots are recorded exactly before owner decomposition or public correction.

Every public operation must declare nonempty responses and explicit security unless it is one of the exact closed migration entries; shared path parameters, error responses, and the five final credential schemes are deterministic, and new operations cannot inherit a waiver.
The canonical public OpenAPI artifact is assembled deterministically from closed, manifest-selected semantic-owner inputs and is the only published OpenAPI contract artifact.

The canonical contract uses OpenAPI 3.1.0, title Cartulary HTTP API, and document version 1.0.0; later breaking wire changes increment the major version, additive public behavior increments the minor version, and non-behavioral contract corrections increment the patch version; every compatibility-waiver class is empty at the stable boundary.
Every canonical runtime operation descriptor remains exact with the baseline OpenAPI operation set while runtime-only and owner-required missing operations remain explicit correction inputs.

The complete public HTTP operation inventory, operation identifiers, response contracts, security classifications, and generated contract snapshots remain bidirectionally consistent with runtime route declarations.
